executive_summary: Getinge delivered solid organic growth of 4.9% in 2024 with particularly strong performance in Acute Care Therapies (+8.2%). However, significant quality challenges in Cardiopulmonary products (Cardiosave, Cardiohelp) led to FDA warnings and CE certificate suspensions, resulting in SEK 848M restructuring costs. Management acknowledges issues openly and has set financial targets of >12% average EPS growth for 2024-2028.
key_highlights: Acute Care Therapies organic growth +8.2%, Life Science -1.9%
Adjusted EBITA SEK 4.9B (14.0% margin, up from 12.2%)
Quality issues: Cardiosave CE suspended, FDA letter on Cardiohelp/HLS
Paragonix acquisition strengthens organ transport portfolio
New financial targets: >12% average adjusted EPS growth 2024-2028
Cash flow from operations SEK 4.6B (up 55% YoY)

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: Help double the number of lives saved among critically ill patients
Enable at least one additional surgery per OR per day
Ensure that medicines for complex diseases reach patients 25% faster
Average adjusted earnings per share growth of above 12%

challenges.challenge: Quality challenges in Cardiopulmonary and Cardiac Assist products

honesty_signals: Directly acknowledges 'we must resolve our quality challenges' as critical priority
Uses Q&A format which is less scripted and more transparent
Admits quality challenges originate from previous years
Openly discusses FDA letters and CE certificate suspensions in Administration Report

key_quotes.quote: With the continued willingness of hospitals and pharmaceutical companies to invest, and our strong market presence, we see many opportunities for continuing to create long-term value and make life-saving technology available to more people.
A critical part of this is that we must resolve our quality challenges.
We stand strong for the future with a clear direction toward sustainability, innovation and global growth.

questions_addressed: How are you leveraging innovation to strengthen your position and create long-term value?
How is Getinge contributing to a more sustainable future?
What are the main priorities moving forward?
What message do you want to send shareholders and other stakeholders about the future of Getinge?

key_narratives: Strong organic growth in Acute Care Therapies driven by ventilator and monitoring solutions
Life Science recovering slowly after destocking effects
Quality challenges requiring significant restructuring investment
Digital solutions (Servo TwinView, T-DOC, Torin) creating competitive advantages
Paragonix acquisition strengthening organ transplantation portfolio
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management frames 2024 as a year of solid commercial progress despite significant quality headwinds. They emphasize the long-term strategic investments in innovation and quality systems while acknowledging short-term costs. The tone suggests confidence in the underlying business strength.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Strong 8.2% organic growth driven by ventilators and monitoring. Quality challenges in Cardiopulmonary products being addressed with action plan 2024-2026. FDA letter impact on US market.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Organic decline of 1.9% due to continued destocking effects. New products launched (SUPR bioreactor, Livit ACE) expected to support future growth.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Modest organic growth of 2.6%. Digitalization focus with FleetView and OR optimization solutions. Strong product pipeline with Maquet Ezea, Aquadis Index, Poladus 150.

operational_highlights: Launch of Servo TwinView - virtual twin for remote ventilator monitoring
Pulsiocare hemodynamic monitoring platform received CE certificate
Paragonix Technologies acquisition - organ transport solutions
17 of 18 manufacturing sites EU MDR certified
CE certificate for ECLS consumables reinstated in September 2024
FDA 510(k) clearance for Vasoview Hemopro 3, Talis, KidneyVault
concerns_mentioned: Cardiosave CE certificate suspended until July 2025
FDA Letter to Health Care Providers on Cardiosave, Cardiohelp, HLS sets
Restructuring costs SEK 848M for Surgical Perfusion phase-out and Cardiosave warranty
Datascope inclusion in FDA Consent Decree

risks.risk: Quality and regulatory compliance in medical devices
FDA enforcement actions and Consent Decree

guidance.commentary: New financial targets set in May 2024 with focus on EPS growth. No explicit revenue or margin guidance provided. Management confident in long-term strategy despite near-term quality challenges.

segments.name: Acute Care Therapies
segments.management_commentary: Strong 8.2% organic growth. Focus on resolving Cardiopulmonary quality challenges. Key launches include Servo TwinView and Pulsiocare. Paragonix acquisition strengthens organ transport.

segments.name: Life Science
segments.management_commentary: Organic decline 1.9% due to customer destocking. New product launches (SUPR bioreactor, GEW 888 neo). Partnership with 908 Devices for bioreactor monitoring.

segments.name: Surgical Workflows
segments.management_commentary: Modest 2.6% organic growth. Focus on digitalization and workflow optimization. Key launches include FleetView, Maquet Ezea, Aquadis Index, Poladus 150.
